input.quote: 13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.
input.rationale: The licence provisions meet the preferred position in full. Section 13.1 grants the subscription/access right to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf" for their internal business purposes, so affiliates and contractors are covered without any notice condition. Section 13.2 grants a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence" for paid-up software and Vendor Technology (including material embedded in Deliverables, confirmed by Section 14.3). Section 13.3 bars Vendor from revoking or suspending a licence "except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure," so the subscription licence is not revocable at will. Section 13.3 also permits Customer to transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24, and Section 24.1 lets Customer assign without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets; Section 24.4 further blocks Vendor from repricing or terminating on a Customer change of control. Section 13.4's use restrictions are narrow (reverse engineering, interference, security bypass, unlawful use) and expressly do not limit authorized security testing or use of Customer Data and output, so they do not cut back the grant. No redline is warranted.
